data.name: MWH2_001
data.value: Those kids of mine...[pause=0] They're sweet,[pause=10] but they're not the brightest.

data.name: MWH2_002
data.value: I wonder where they get it from?

data.name: MWH2_003
data.value: ...Ooowwaaaa...[pause=0] Lower the drawbridge...

data.name: MWH2_004
data.value: ...Your king wishes to swim in his royal moat...[pause=0] Fwwwwaaaahhhhh....

data.name: MWH3_001
data.value: It's got me worried about my own kids.[pause=0] They're quite prone to wandering themselves.

data.name: MWH3_002
data.value: I hope they won't go off somewhere where they would need rescuing...

data.name: MWH3_003
data.value: They've wandered off plenty of times before and they always find their way back home safely.

data.name: MWH3_004
data.value: Worse comes to worse,[pause=10] the guild could rescue them like they rescued {0},[pause=10] right?

data.name: MWH4_001
data.value: Then I'll turn myself in for the bounty they're sure to put on me!

data.name: MWH4_002
data.value: Haha![pause=0] Dream castle,[pause=10] you will be mine!

data.name: MWH6_001
data.value: Three famous rivals in town, and they haven't sold a SINGLE souvenir yet![pause=0] The market is WIDE open.

data.name: MWH6_002
data.value: Team Dazzling branded scarves.[pause=0] Team Dazzling branded mugs.[pause=0] Team Dazzling branded... me, honestly, if the price is right.

data.name: MWH6_003
data.value: Tweed wants to sell "authentic Dazzling merchandise."[pause=0] He has never spoken to them once.

data.name: MWH6_004
data.value: Details, he says.[pause=0] Boooon...[pause=10] I give it three days before he gives up.

data.name: MWH6_005
data.value: The whole guild's off fighting a forest guardian and I'm stuck here selling nothing.[pause=0] Timing, right?

data.name: MWH6_006
data.value: Next big idea's brewing though.[pause=0] I can feel it. Any day now.

data.name: MWH6_007
data.value: You did it![pause=0] Now THAT'S a story worth selling tickets for.

data.name: MWH6_008
data.value: "Guided Tour: The Bug Rescue."[pause=0] I'm already sketching the poster.

data.name: MWH6_009
data.value: Booon...[pause=0] Glad the little one's home. Glad Tweed's poster idea died with the moment.

data.name: MWH6_010
data.value: Booon...[pause=0] Another quiet morning, minus Tweed's shouting about souvenirs.
